name: Vermont Steel Erection and Fabrication
old_description: Gerard Bellavance founded United Steel Erectors in 1998. Since then, our name has changed, employees have come and gone, and Gerard’s sons; Gabriel, Eliott, and Addison have joined the leadership team. What hasn’t changed is our dedication to doing good work
about:
Vermont Steel Erection and Fabrication is based in Wolcott, Vermont. The company traces its roots to 1998 when Gerard Bellavance founded United Steel Erectors. The business remains family-owned; Bellavance's sons Gabriel, Eliott, and Addison have since joined the leadership team, and the name was later changed to Vermont Steel Erection and Fabrication.

The company provides steel erection, steel fabrication, and welding services across New England. Its shop handles MIG, TIG, and stick welding, and crews can also travel to job sites for mobile welding. Work ranges from structural steel installation to custom fabrication of items such as vehicle frames, heavy-equipment components, dumpsters, and storage racks.

Customers include contractors, equipment owners, and fabricators who need structural steel erected or custom metalwork produced. The company cites projects involving vehicles, heavy equipment, dumpsters, and racks as typical examples of its welding and fabrication work.

Vermont Steel Erection and Fabrication emphasizes a safety-first culture, a record of never failing to complete a job satisfactorily, and a commitment to quick, efficient turnaround. The firm attributes its approach to over 50 years of combined experience and a family-owned dedication to customer satisfaction.
